name: Disneyland Harbour Galley Famous Fresh-Baked Warm Chocolate Chip Cookies (6-Pack)
whyItWorks: Disneyland's most viral snack: bite-sized, gooey, fresh-from-the-oven chocolate chip cookies made with white flour, butter, and semi-sweet chocolate chips (zero nuts, oats, or seeds).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share the 6-pack with family and enjoy 1–2 small warm cookies after a protein meal, taking a lactase enzyme if sensitive to butter/milk chocolate.
watchOuts: High butter and sugar if you eat the whole box solo—pace yourself to 1–2 cookies
